# peakst8 Embed

> peakst8 Embed lets run clubs and fitness communities sell events on their own website. Event pages are server-rendered on the club's domain with Event and FAQ schema, so they rank on Google and get cited by AI answer engines. peakst8 runs checkout, payments, refunds and check-in.

- [Product note](https://arth6025.github.io/peakst8-embed/): ICP, the problem, launch-to-scale path, SEO and AEO requirements, architecture, V1 scope, FAQ, open questions
- [Prototype](https://arth6025.github.io/peakst8-embed/prototype/): clickable V1 screens (admin A1, organiser O1–O7, attendee E1–E6, club registration C1–C3) with states and build notes
